renamed._doc: old seat label -> new (Alex, 11-05). `factory.mjs rename` moves the board's records; up/down find panes still under the old label.

scout._doc: Sentry scout (Alex, 11-09): a free sbx stream with nothing to dispatch scans these projects. At most maxProposals per run, gapHours between runs, paused while maxUntriaged proposals wait for triage. Remove to turn it off.

hints.untriaged: Not classified yet. New items are triaged automatically.
hints.ready: No open questions. Can start with what's written.
hints.clarify: Blocked on an answer below before starting.
hints.rewrite: The task itself is unclear or contradicts itself.
hints.human: Most of this needs a person, not an agent.
hints.progress: An agent is working on it right now: a started assignment on the record or, for a PR, on any task or child in it.
hints.waiting: Waiting on someone or something outside the build: a QA owner, a source to confirm, or an undecided scope question. Each card says who and what.
hints.history: Finished or closed work, kept as history.
hints.prreview: The PR is open and ready, and nobody is working on it: waiting on human review or approval.

standing.quote: So long as a PR goes through internal review im good with it being marked ready

prApproval._why: A new PR no Teamwork task asked for waits for Alex's go on the dashboard (Alex, 11-09). A source here needs no click: a type (teamwork) or type:by (agent:local-head).

standingWaiver.reason: PR already marked ready; internal review is only needed before marking a PR ready
standingWaiver.authorization: Alex 2026-10-27: "waive any internal review on something that is already marked ready"; Alex 2026-10-28: "we only need internal review before marking a PR as ready, not after every single change we make"

factory._doc: Fixed seats of the software factory; streams come from routing.supervisors. bin/factory.mjs brings them up.

_comment: V2 owns its config (V1 is frozen, 10-30). Streams have no topic words (decision 8). roles maps a seat label to its role; every routing.supervisors label is a stream-supervisor.

seatRecycle._doc: Restart idle Claude seats (not stays) fresh once a day in this UTC hour; sbx workers use recycle instead.

recycle._restartStale: Restart a worker fresh between jobs (same sandbox). W-198: the sandbox marks the auto-mode offer seen, and the unblocker declines it if it still shows (Alex, 11-06).
